footnote_text: Represents the donation of 400,000 shares of common stock of KKR & Co. Inc. by a limited partnership (the "Partnership"), which is an entity controlled by the Reporting Person, to a charitable foundation in which the Reporting Person has no pecuniary interest. As previously reported on a Form 4 filed on May 18, 2018, these shares of common stock were being held by the Partnership solely for purposes of future charitable donations, and the Partnership continues to hold the remaining shares for future donations.
